title: A Cold Day
text:
Today the weather is cold and rainy. Anna wears a warm coat, a hat and black boots. She also has a red scarf. Her coat is long and green.

Her brother Tom is inside the house. He wears a T-shirt and shorts because the house is warm. He likes light clothes.

questions.text: What does Anna wear on her head?
Why does Anna wear a warm coat and boots?
options: Because it is cold and rainy
Because she is at a party

questions.text: How does Tom probably feel inside the house?

vocabulary.definition: a long piece of cloth worn around the neck
shoes that cover the foot and the ankle
short trousers that end above the knee

paragraph_translations: Dzisiaj pogoda jest zimna i deszczowa. Anna ma na sobie ciepły płaszcz, czapkę i czarne buty. Ma też czerwony szalik. Jej płaszcz jest długi i zielony.
Jej brat Tom jest w domu. Ma na sobie T-shirt i szorty, bo w domu jest ciepło. Lubi lekkie ubrania.
